misconceptions.description: Believing the model retrieves stored answers.
misconceptions.trigger: learner says the chatbot 'searched its database'
misconceptions.feedback: A language model generates text from learned probabilities. Some tools also search the web, but the writing itself is generated.

misconceptions.description: Trusting text because it is fluent and confident.
misconceptions.trigger: learner accepts an answer because it 'sounds right'
misconceptions.feedback: Fluency comes from predicting likely words. Check facts against sources, especially names, numbers and citations.
